arcane-archer.summary: An archer trained in an old elven art of weaving spells into ammunition for magical shots, in and out of battle.

Arcane Archer Lore.summary: Learn Druidcraft or Prestidigitation (INT casting) and gain Arcana and Nature; for each you already have, pick another Fighter level 1 skill instead.

Arcane Shot.summary: Know 2 Arcane Shot options (one more at Fighter 7, 10, 15 and 18, each time swapping one if you like). Once per turn, add one to a hit with an Ammunition weapon; INT modifier uses (min 1) per Short or Long Rest. Die d6 (d8 at 10, d10 at 15, d12 at 18); save DC 8 + PB + INT.

Curving Shot.summary: Bonus Action after an Ammunition weapon attack misses: make a new attack roll against another creature you see in range and within 60 ft of the first target.

Magical Ammunition.summary: Magic action: shoot enchanted nonmagical ammunition at a surface you see for one effect (Darkening, Unlocking or Vine); a Magic action pulls it free early. Once per Short or Long Rest; a Second Wind use restores it.

options.name: Darkening Ammunition
options.summary: For 1 minute, shadows fill a 15-ft Emanation: mundane fires go out and creatures inside take -5 to Wisdom (Perception) and Passive Perception.

options.name: Unlocking Ammunition
options.summary: Each object in a 15-ft Emanation that's mundanely locked, stuck or barred opens (one lock per object); the knock is heard 300 ft away.

options.name: Vine Ammunition
options.summary: A climbable 120-ft vine sprouts and lasts 10 minutes.

Ever-Ready Shot.summary: Rolling Initiative gives back one spent Arcane Shot use.

Indomitable Teleport.summary: When a save you reroll with Indomitable succeeds, teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space you see.

Masterful Shots.summary: Reaction when a creature you see misses you with an attack: back off from it by up to half your Speed without provoking, then make a ranged attack at it if it's in range.
